'''Qi Lozar''' was a desert [[Planet/Legends|world]] that was located in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It served as a haven for hermits, [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] and other individuals who were trying to escape their pasts.<ref name="Atlas Extra" />
